profile: Metaphysicist weapons + allowed special attacks (for AOBuddy10 bot decision-making)

dataSource.itemData: the OmniCell datafiles\items.ocp (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3, client 18.8.50_EP1) - full converted item pack
dataSource.note: A weapon's wield requirements live in its ToWield action (OmniCell.Enums.ActionType.ToWield=8). Operator.GreaterThan(2) means 'stat >= value'. Special-attack stats present in those requirements = the specials that weapon allows. Requirement VALUES scale with the template's QL (low/high endpoints); values shown are for the listed QL.

howToReadSpecialsAtRuntime: For the equipped weapon, read its ToWield criteria: any requirement whose stat is in specialAttackStats is a special that weapon allows (the value is the skill needed at that QL). Wield-skill stat(s) give the weapon type. This mirrors the item data exactly.

specialAttackStats.note: BowSpecialAttack(121) is a support SKILL for bow Aimed Shot, not an on-demand special; a bow's on-demand special still shows as AimedShot(151)/FlingShot(150) in criteria.

professionRestrictionEncoding.form: A ToWield Requirement with Statnumber=60. Operator EqualTo(0) + Value=<professionId> locks the weapon to that one profession.
professionRestrictionEncoding.mpUsableRule: Weapon is MP-equippable unless it has a Profession EqualTo lock to a profession other than 12 (or Unequal/Not 12). Weapons with no profession requirement are usable by any profession if the skill is met. 59 weapons are locked EqualTo Metaphysicist(12).
professionRestrictionEncoding.example: id 271438 'Bow-Blaster - 402' ql300: ToWield = Bow>=1500, AimedShot>=750, no profession lock -> MP-usable.

dualWieldAndMultiSkills.note: wield now lists EVERY trainable-skill requirement in the weapon's ToWield action (weapon skill(s) plus any Multi Melee/Multi Ranged or other skill), each as {skill, requiredValue}. specials lists the on-demand special-attack skills.
dualWieldAndMultiSkills.finding: In this data (client 18.8.50_EP1) MultiMelee(101)/MultiRanged(134) appear as a ToWield criterion on ONLY 6 weapons - all 'Small Ebony Figurine' variants locked to Soldier/Engineer/Fixer/Agent/Adventurer/Enforcer (NOT Metaphysicist). No MP-usable weapon carries a Multi requirement.
dualWieldAndMultiSkills.dualWieldMechanic: Dual-wielding is gated by the CHARACTER's Multi Melee / Multi Ranged skill for the off-hand slot, not by a per-weapon ToWield criterion. An MP dual-wields by training Multi Ranged/Melee and equipping two normal weapons (e.g. two Pistols); each weapon still only requires its own wield skill in criteria.

usableWeaponTypes.role: Primary MP ranged weapon line (signature). MP-only Shadowlands bows + generic bows.
Common MP ranged option; single or dual-wield.
Melee / energy shields (often paired with Melee Energy).
Cheap melee skill; MP-only 2he weapons exist.
MP-only energy weapons/shields (Jupiter Aegis, The Argument).

metaphysicistOnlyWeapons.note: These have a Profession EqualTo Metaphysicist(12) lock in ToWield - designed for MPs. Names include Sprite Bow, Bow of Sympathy, Shank of Maze, Howlet, Panther, Jupiter Aegis, The Argument.

technicallyEquippableButAtypical.note: Any weapon whose only gate is a wield skill can be equipped by an MP IF that skill is raised (implants/buffs), but these types are not part of normal MP play (expensive weapon IP for a nano profession). Counts are MP-usable weapons present in the data.

unverifiedOrCaveats: MP skill-cost color (which weapon skills are 'green'/cheap) comes from AOWiki (wiki.aodb.us Meta-Physicist / Meta-Physicist:Weapons), not from items.ocp. items.ocp gates weapons by skill value, not by an MP-specific cost.
Requirement values scale with QL; a single named weapon spans a QL range (low/high templates). Values shown are for the exact template QL listed.
EquipSlot (Weap_RightHand 0x06 / Weap_LeftHand 0x08) is not stored in items.ocp; weapon identity here = 'has a ToWield action requiring a weapon wield skill'.
